block: ot_hbm_integrated_su_cp_context (HBM CP, SU_PIN_MARGIN, main 833cb68de, view physical/hbm_cp_pin_margin_20261006)
placement_note: The CP is not a die master in r16h: it lives inside the integrated SU parent (hfd_su region, hub fork), so it has no die-level nets; its context paths are parent-internal. Vehicle: every CP pin bit driven / captured by an ASAP7 DFFHQNx1 neighbour flop (236 bits), 6 fF per net, CP ETM SS/FF, 833.333 ps, 60 ps setup / 25 ps hold uncertainty, neighbour clock skew swept (positive = neighbours later than the CP clock).
verdict: Setup clean in every case (>= +156 ps). Hold is the watch item: flop-direct neighbours meet hold only while they are no more than ~+20 ps early relative to the CP clock (+18 ps at zero skew; -32 ps at 50 ps early; -132 ps at 150 ps early, worst on CP inputs launch_pc / cp_job / por_n). Adoption condition: the SU parent route must hold-repair the CP input nets against its real local skew (or keep the CP on the same clock leaf as its drivers); the block-level FF +15.97 / I2R +43.24 does not cover an early-clocked parent driver.
